title: Typed arithmetic component API

source.anchor: ### Requirement: UIREQ-030 Typed arithmetic component API

requirement: WHEN arithmetic lowering selects a word layout, it SHALL expose named full-result components with the exact checked UInt128 semantic wrapper.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Carry, borrow and full product
scenarios.when: b is 32 or 64 and checkedU128Add/Sub/Mul use little-endian limbs.
scenarios.then: addCarry_b(a,bv,carryIn) returns named {low,carryOut}, subBorrow_b(a,bv,borrowIn) returns {low,borrowOut}, and mulWide_b(a,bv) returns {low,high}; carry/borrow bits and multiply-accumulate whole-word carries have distinct types. The wrappers retain K mathematical-result/error10 meaning, including the full up-to-256-bit product before checked UInt128 selection. Independently specified normal results are (2^32−3)+8 = 2^32+5, (2^64+9)−7 = 2^64+2, and (2^48+1)·3 = 3·2^48+3; no layout or row-cost winner is selected.
unasserted: named component API addCarry_b / subBorrow_b / mulWide_b returning {low,carryOut}/{low,borrowOut}/{low,high} (not exposed through the CLI)

checks.label: full product above UInt128 is error10
